Title: Search box offers suggestions for a real product
Question: Presence
Steps: 1. Open https://www.bytepe.com/all-products  2. Click the search box in the header  3. Type "iphone"  4. Wait for the suggestion dropdown
Expected result: The search box is visible and at least one suggestion appears.
Notes: Proves the dropdown works, so the zero-result checks below mean "no match" rather than "search never ran".

Title: Top suggestions for "iphone" are relevant
Question: Correctness
Steps: 1. Search for "iphone"  2. Read the first 5 suggestions
Expected result: Each of the top 5 suggestions mentions "iphone".
Actual result: Top 5 all iPhones. 13 of the remaining 15 do NOT mention iPhone.
Notes: The tail is padded with Apple accessories and drifts as far as "Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra Samsung" and an Ambrane power bank. Not asserted, but logged every run so growth is visible.

Title: Top suggestions for "apple" are relevant
Question: Correctness
Steps: 1. Search for "apple"  2. Read the first 5 suggestions
Expected result: Each of the top 5 suggestions mentions "apple".
Notes: Brand search works because each suggestion is labelled "<product> <brand>", so a brand term matches even when the product name does not contain it.

Title: Changing the term changes the suggestions
Question: Behaviour
Steps: 1. Search "iphone" and note the suggestions  2. Search "galaxy"  3. Compare the two lists
Expected result: The second list differs from the first and contains Galaxy products.
Notes: Replaces the requested pagination check. There is no results page, so there is no pagination — this asks the equivalent question of the control that does exist.

Title: Symbol-only search returns nothing and does not break the page
Question: Negative
Steps: 1. Search "iphone" to prove the dropdown works  2. Search the currency symbol on its own  3. Check the catalogue is still on screen
Expected result: Zero suggestions, page still usable, still on the products URL.
Notes: Handled gracefully — no crash, no error page.

Title: Empty search does not navigate away
Question: Negative
Steps: 1. Clear the search box  2. Press Enter  3. Check the URL and the page
Expected result: No navigation, no suggestions, catalogue still visible.
Actual result: URL unchanged, 0 suggestions, 12 product links still shown, no error message.
Notes: The site shows all products rather than an error. That is the behaviour being pinned, not a judgement that it is right.

Title: There is no search results page
Question: Contract
Steps: 1. Search "iphone" and press Enter  2. Check whether the URL changed  3. Request /search?q=iphone directly
Notes: Deliberate guard. If a results page is ever added this test fails, which is the signal to revisit every "no results page" assumption in the spec.

Test ID: Verify search results page loads (URL contains /search)
Title: No results page exists. Enter does not navigate; /search returns 404.

Test ID: Verify ALL results contain the search term
Title: Relevance is token-based. "samsung galaxy" returns 20 Galaxy products, none containing that literal phrase. Would fail on any multi-word query.

Test ID: Click a result, then go back to search results
Title: There is no results list to return to. Picking a suggestion goes straight to the product page.
No results page, so no pagination. The dropdown is capped at 20.

Test ID: Empty search shows an error message
Title: No error is shown. The catalogue stays on screen. Test pins actual behaviour.
